description: This file defines the JsonCodecOptions class within the Orleans.Serialization namespace. It provides configuration options for JSON serialization including serializer, reader, writer options, and delegate functions to determine if a type is serializable or copyable.

classes.description: A class encapsulating options for JSON serialization and deserialization, including serializer, reader, writer configurations, and type validation delegates.
